title: The x402 Economy
subtitle: How the Web's Unused Payment Code Became a Way for Software to Pay, and What It Has Earned So Far
author: 561 Group
description: How the web’s unused payment code became a way for software to pay, and what it has earned so far: HTTP 402’s history, one paid request step by step, who governs x402, its rivals, the market measurements, security and US law.
